note: Older family-run RV park in a shaded grove off I-29 at Tea, about 10 minutes from Sioux Falls. Gravel roads that turn muddy in wet weather; laundry and washrooms in the old farmhouse, and a pool. Mostly seasonal: about 10 of its 73 sites are sold by the night. No website or online booking; call ahead. --Claude
summary: No operator website (redbarnrvpark.com is an Arizona park); RoverPass unclaimed. Good Sam (Wayback 2025-11) gives 73 spaces of which 63 seasonal / 10 available, 30/50 A, 10 full-hookup pull-thrus to 60 ft, open all year, 'From $55'. Google 4.1/177, RV Life avg $41. DROP CANDIDATE: mostly seasonal with no operator rate or presence beyond Google (long-stay test 2). Not waterfront; pin fine.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (long-stay / mostly seasonal + iffy): Good Sam directory (Wayback 2025-11-20) 'Total spaces: 73', 'Spaces available: 10', 'Seasonal Sites: 63' - about 1 site in 7 sold by the night (passes test 4 at 10%+, but mostly seasonal). Reviews mention work crews and two-week stays alongside one-night stays. Per the 2026-11-11 rule (mostly seasonal AND iffy: no rate, no website) this is a drop candidate; reviewer's call.

PRICE GATE (unconfirmed): Good Sam's 'From $55 / night' is over $50; it is a Good Sam Park (directory gs true, 2026-10-02), so 10% off = $49.50 - passes narrowly if that figure holds. No gateway within 40 km. Price not written (aggregator-only, conflicting).
